steps.caption: Open Deal toolkit from the sidebar.
Choose Compare options under Lease vs managed office.
How to read this page opens a short guide to every box and label on this screen.
Compare 250 seats over 36 months — both options use the same seats and period.
Conventional: rent, CAM, fit-out, furniture, deposit and running costs.
Managed: ₹14,000 per seat per month, 12-month lock-in.
Ticked services are already in the seat price, so they are not added again.
Only extras billed on top go under Charged separately — here, parking.
Weights: what matters most to the client — cost, flexibility, commitment, speed, control.
Compare & save — calculated by fixed formulas, not AI.
The answer: cheaper over the period, and better on the client's weighted criteria — with reasons.
Totals over 36 months and cost per seat per month, side by side.
Side by side: one-off costs, refundable deposit, lock-in and flexibility.
Cost over time: running totals month by month — dashed is conventional, solid is managed.
Line by line: every cost behind each total; included services show as 'in seat price', not added again.
Quoted = from a landlord or partner document; Estimated = your own assumption. The label follows the number everywhere.
How we calculated this: the formula version and every step, so anyone can check the maths.
Each save is a version. Change any input and recalculate — earlier versions are kept, never overwritten.
Download deck makes an editable PowerPoint of these results for the client.
